options.description: What is said. Wraps to the toast's width; escape sequences are dropped.
options.name: message

options.description: Draw the border with ASCII only. Defaults to what `unicodeSupported()` says, which is the rule `note()` and the modal keep.
options.name: ascii

options.description: How many toasts the corner holds at once, counting this one. Defaults to 3.
options.name: max

options.description: Called once, when it goes, with why.
options.name: onClose

options.description: The toast's own props: a margin, a class. Geometry only, never a colour.
options.name: props

options.description: Whether this toast is progress rather than the answer -- `MountOptions.quiet`.
options.name: quiet

options.description: The terminal `--quiet` and the screen are read against. Defaults to the process's.
options.name: terminal

options.description: How long it stays, in milliseconds. Defaults to 4000.
options.name: timeout

options.description: Which role colours it -- the border, the title and the message. Defaults to `note`, which is no role at all: the terminal's own foreground.
options.name: variant

options.description: How wide it is, in cells. It never exceeds the screen. Defaults to 32.
options.name: width

api.signature: function showToast(host: ToastHost, opts: ToastOptions): ToastHandle

registryDescription: A toast: a timed message in a corner of the screen that stacks, never takes the focus, and stays out of --quiet
